body:
Three unpublished Worker 1 stock proposals turn a storage or autoclaving atmosphere into an asserted material component:

- `CS-PROP-NBRC361_NEUTRALIZED_SULFIDE_STOCK`: Nitrogen is listed as a component based on autoclaving under N2 and sealed storage.
- `CS-PROP-NBRC1321_SULFIDE_STOCK`: Nitrogen is listed as a component based on storage under N2 after filtration.
- `KG26-PROP-186-IDENTITY` / `DSMZ863_Sodium_Carbonate_Stock`: Carbon dioxide is listed as a component based on autoclaving sealed vessels under CO2.

The captured [NBRC361](https://www.nite.go.jp/nbrc/catalogue/NBRCMediumDetailServlet?NO=361), [NBRC1321](https://www.nite.go.jp/nbrc/catalogue/NBRCMediumDetailServlet?NO=1321) and [DSMZ863](https://www.dsmz.de/microorganisms/medium/pdf/DSMZ_Medium863.pdf) instructions establish those preparation conditions. They do not specify the gas as a material ingredient or provide a dissolved-gas specification for these stocks. `MAPPING_SEMANTICS.md` section 6 defines `components` as material has-part, not every participant in a preparation procedure.

Retain the atmosphere conditions and exact source provenance in notes/evidence. Remove unsupported gas-component assertions, or supply direct applicable evidence for material inclusion. Recheck component completeness against the source's actual material inputs. Do not invent gas amounts or final dissolved speciation.

Keep the explicit CO2 saturation of the separate bicarbonate preparations distinct: there the source does describe introducing CO2 into the solution, without establishing a numerical concentration. This finding does not remove that sourced distinction or merge any owners.

Independent finding: `.temp/all-unmatched-20261107/preflight/w01-shard-coordinator-review-v2/finding-004-atmosphere-partonomy.json`, SHA256 `34b1123989cef7421dc05cf926f2001c18d0fac12a43463da83eabba8dc48d71`. It binds exact frozen payloads, source captures and case IDs. A coordinator check of the current proposals still found all three gas components. Current issue deduplication and the worker's artifact-finding/issue-plan files showed no existing tracker for this specific defect.

Correct only proposal artifacts through the guarded writer, preserve earlier versions and obtain independent re-review. No maintained data, scientific hold or release disposition has changed for this finding.
